Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have linked additional capacity to binding commitment; it sounds like certainty about future demand is what helps you reserve capacity. If you can secure our full requirement, we are ready to commit long-term and support predictable production planning. How can we translate that commitment into a dependable allocation covering our full requirement?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at EUR 28.94 until December 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10). Your on-time delivery over the last 12 months was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. Our offer stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. The contract term is reflected in the price. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Any further step needs approval from our management. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You repeat your lead time and explicitly recognise the value of a longer commitment—it sounds like predictable capacity planning is central for you. We are ready to support that planning with a firm long-term commitment, provided our full requirement is secured. How can we translate that certainty into a firm allocation that works for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.94 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, our management has approved a further step. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We offer a price of €30.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. The contract term is reflected in the price. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
